questions.stem: 1. 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은? [2점]
questions.passage: Reading a wide variety of books exposes students to different perspectives and vocabulary that a single genre cannot provide. Teachers who encourage diverse reading habits often see stronger critical thinking skills develop in their students over time.
choices: ① 독서는 어휘력 향상에만 도움이 된다.
② 다양한 장르의 독서는 비판적 사고력을 기르는 데 도움이 된다.
③ 교사는 학생에게 특정 장르만 추천해야 한다.
④ 독서 습관은 유전적 요인에 의해 결정된다.

questions.stem: 2. 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 옳은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은? [3점]
questions.passage: Scientists who study animal behavior (A) [has / have] found that many species communicate in ways once thought unique to humans. Some researchers believe this discovery (B) [challenge / challenges] long-held assumptions about the boundary between human and animal cognition, and they argue that future studies (C) [is / are] likely to reveal even more surprising parallels.

questions.lead_text: Many cities around the world are redesigning public spaces to be more accessible.
